description: Values 1 to 2000 sampled once, 5000 three times and 6000 twice: n = S = 2005, T = 20050. 5000 is common (3 x 1000 >= 2005) with (2 x 3 x 20050 + 2005) / 4010 = 30 rows; 6000 is not (2 x 1000 < 2005), so it is in the list twice, at positions 2000 and 2001 after 1 to 2000. h = 2002, so m = min(1000, 2001) = 1000 and bound j is at position j x 2001 / 1000: positions 0, 2, 4, ... give 1, 3, 5, ...; bound 500 is position 1000, the value 1001; bound 999 is position 1998, the value 1999; and bound 1000 is position 2001, the value 6000. H = 20050 - 0 - 30 = 20020.
